title: Take God's Help
verse: For this reason I tell you, whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
observation: Jesus gives us a promise. He says that when we are walking in His will and ways, nothing will be denied to us. We have to be careful because we can sometimes take this verse out of context and think it means we can indulge our desires. The meaning is He will not deny His children anything they need to do His will.
application: What am I trying to do without God's help?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for empowering us with all we need to make a difference.
